title: Depth field: choose a variant
question: You picked the Demoscene depth field. Here it is beside three close variants that change what carries the depth. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: Depth field (original)
options.thesis: Sparse star layers drift behind a still, bright front plane; rank is brightness and depth; nothing is boxed.
options.viewport: Name and intro on the front plane; experience one depth back, dimmer and wider-spaced.
options.risk: Near-black void; the darkest of the four.

options.label: Horizon floor
options.lineage: 80s vector demos: a perspective grid floor running to a horizon
options.thesis: A receding grid floor gives the page a horizon; the experience timeline runs along that horizon like a scroller, frozen still.
options.viewport: Name and intro high on the front plane; at the horizon, a timeline of roles with year ticks; the grid floor fades out below it.
options.risk: The floor grid reads synthwave if it glows or gets neon; it must stay hairline and dim.

options.label: Grid planes
options.lineage: Demoscene parallax, with grids in place of stars
options.thesis: Three grid planes at different scales and brightness stack behind the text and shift at different speeds as you scroll; the finest grid is nearest.
materials: timeline bars on the nearest grid
options.viewport: Name and intro snapped to the nearest grid; experience as bars on a year axis drawn in that grid's cells.
options.risk: Three grids can become busy; only the nearest may carry content.

options.label: Focus pull
options.lineage: Demoscene depth, with blur as distance
options.thesis: Depth is focus: secondary content sits slightly back and softened, and hovering or tabbing to it pulls it forward into sharp focus.
options.viewport: Front plane sharp: name, intro, links. Behind it, a timeline of roles slightly softened; the current role already in focus.
options.risk: Blurred text must stay readable at rest; the blur is small and always clears on focus.
